title: 储户排队与银行压力
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Wide street-level shot of a modest American bank entrance in 1931. A long orderly queue of ordinary depositors in period coats waits outside heavy stone doors. A bank employee quietly speaks to the first person in line. Natural worried faces. The queue bends along the bank facade, no violence, no readable signs.
